why: Messages window needs virtualized scroll, mouse, OSC 52, images
imsg is taken on npm by a 2022 AppleScript stub
illegal combos must not compile, UI is a projection
tests and --fake must not need a live Mac
Messages chrome is list plus transcript plus composer
runs on the Mac over SSH with no server, password, or keychain; ROWID watch resume and exclusive history bounds avoid BlueBubbles pagination gaps
imsg is the name of the CLI it drives; the same name could spawn itself

decision: sixel strips per cell row, repainted from Ink's write stream
why: Windows Terminal has sixel but no kitty graphics; text written over a cell erases its image, and Ink rewrites whole lines

decision: chat service from the GUID prefix, else the newest message
why: merged any;-; chats keep a stale service_name; message.send_status reports each row's service

decision: conversation pane follows the list highlight; Enter or Tab opens it
why: j/k should show a conversation without Enter; only an explicit open marks read, since with the bridge that sends receipts; one highlight load in flight keeps imsg's single query free; a picture waits 150 ms before its first showing so moving past a conversation sends none
